title: A map I made of Mallworld in 2006
content: This is a map i made in 2006 from my dreams. Some of it relates to real world locations in my city, but most does not. However, the dreams have been consistent enough over the years that i can relate locations to each other in placement. As you can see, the Malls are heavily present (center and north). I have always wanted to expand upon it, but would need an absurd amount of space for all the details. Sorry for the chicken scratch writing; i never made it for anyone but myself, for fun.
